about_the_game:
Shipwreck Discovery is a fully immersive SCUBA Diving game where you can explore actual full-scale shipwrecks around the world in stunning detail. Experience the thrill of underwater adventure as if you were diving these actual wrecks. Discover marine life, uncover the secrets of real-world wrecks, see what divers see without ever getting wet!

Explore Real Shipwreck Video Footage

Dive into authentic full-scale digital twins of actual shipwrecks, meticulously recreated from dive maps, photos, and site surveys. Every bolt, deck plate, and collapsed hull section is in the right place. At certain locations around the wrecks you can scan and watch actual video footage of what it really looks like diving it in real life. This is great for divers who plan to visit and dive these wrecks in the future. Plus, earn Discovery Bucks simply by watching these in-game videos!

Training Tool for Divers

Practice navigation, air management, currents and more in a zero-risk VR environment - perfect for new divers and seasoned wreck explorers alike. Or maybe you want to become a diver someday - this will help you get comfortable before you get wet.

Look, Listen, Learn & Earn!

Fish Scanning & Education at it's best! Scan fish, unlock stunning marine life videos, and add them to your Dive Log for later review. It’s like combining a marine field guide with a video game achievement system. There are tons of videos about the many sea life creatures - all narrated by Dr. Steve Gittings - the Former Chief Scientist for NOAA's Office of National Marine Sanctuaries! With so many cool creatures to scan, you can become a fish expert while earning Discovery Bucks to upgrade your diving experience! 

Hang on for the Ride!

Imagine holding on tight as you can as you ride the back of a great white shark, a manta ray and more, slicing through the water with effortless power. From this vantage point, you see the ocean exactly as the large creatures do. Every turn, every surge forward, gives you a thrilling, heart-pounding glimpse into the life of some of the ocean’s most legendary creatures.

Immersive VR Realism

Experience the weightless drift of a dive, realistic breathing sounds, the eerie beauty of light and particles cutting through the deep and so much more. This is a divers best resource for practicing a wreck dive without getting wet. It's also perfect for players who want to scuba dive some day. Want to be a marine biologist? Learn about the ocean and its inhabitants from these artificial reefs. This game puts the Reality in VR!

Customizable Dive Conditions

Want perfect dive conditions with crystal-clear water? Or a challenging low-visibility dive? You have full control to create the perfect practice dive:

  • Visibility - From clear conditions to nearly zero visibility

  • Currents - 360 degrees of easy to extremely challenging current capabilities

  • Surface Waves - Create the surface waves from easy to extremely challenging

  • Sound & More - This is your game so create the dive conditions you want

Marine Conservation Connection

You’re not just playing - you’re helping. Every download supports Lionfish Central’s nonprofit mission with real-world marine conservation, artificial reefs, invasive species control, coral restoration, and ocean protection programs - just to name a few! Who knew playing a fun VR game could help save the oceans!

Interactive Local Directory

Discover actual dive shops, charters, restaurants and more at each shipwreck you dive. The game's directory helps divers plan virtual adventure into a real-life dive trip. By the time a diver arrives to these locations they've learned the wreck in all condition, know what dive shops and charters to choose and even know where they want to eat after the dives!

Regular Content Updates

New updates, cool features, fish and shipwreck locations added regularly throughout the year. Frequent content drops and new gameplay modes is sure to keep this game as endless as the ocean!

Immersive VR Realism

Experience the weightless drift of a dive, realistic breathing sounds, and the eerie beauty of light and particles cutting through the deep. This is the closest thing to scuba diving without getting wet. It's a scuba divers resource - it's an immersive game - it's a local directory - it's an educational tool so much more!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Minimum: Windows 10 (64-bit), version 1903 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 or AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • VR Support: OpenXR
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X (or better)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / 3070 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT / 6800
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Dive into Shipwreck Discovery, the most realistic scuba diving VR game ever made! Explore actual shipwrecks in stunning detail, customize dive conditions, discover marine life, and uncover hidden treasures - all while supporting ocean conservation. Your ultimate underwater adventure awaits! Dive in!

English*, French, German, Russian, Spanish - Spain
